links=[]
for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',text):
 if not re.match(r'^(https?:|#)',target):

ns={'dc':'http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/','cp':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties'}

 info=subprocess.run(['pdfinfo',str(pdf)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout
 with zipfile.ZipFile(docx) as z:
  x=E.fromstring(z.read('docProps/core.xml'))

  body=' '.join(E.fromstring(z.read('word/document.xml')).itertext())
 pdftext=subprocess.run(['pdftotext',str(pdf),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout
 found={n:{'PDF':n in pdftext,'DOCX_body':n in body} for n in needles}
 assert not creators and not re.search(r'^Author:\s*\S',info,re.M)
 assert not any(v for report in found.values() for v in report.values())
 metadata[lang]={'PDF_nonempty_Author_field':False,'DOCX_nonempty_creator_last_modified_fields':0,'specified_local_path_account_string_screen':found,'scope':'Export metadata and specified visible-text strings, not full author-approved anonymization of manuscript, code, data or archives.'}

 f=json.loads((root/name).read_text())['files'];assert not any(x in f for x in targets)
